principle: every lesson is a transferable RULE with the measurement that produced it; no narration

lessons.rule: A build that is not a function of its source cannot be a release artifact. Export from the object store, never from the disk.
lessons.measurement: git cat-file: objects CRLF=0 while the working tree was CRLF; core.autocrlf=true; no .gitattributes; 7 differing wheel members (all equal after LF normalisation) and 39 differing member timestamps
lessons.failure_it_replaces: filing our own build-input defect as a permanent platform limitation

lessons.rule: Verify reproducibility per ARTIFACT, not per build system. A wheel that is reproducible says nothing about the sdist next to it.
lessons.measurement: the wheel became reproducible while the sdist still carried 21 member mtimes and a wall-clock gzip header
lessons.failure_it_replaces: stopping at the first artifact that worked

lessons.rule: When normalising an archive, strip the extended header, do not just overwrite the field.
lessons.measurement: PAX_FORMAT keeps pax_headers['mtime']; create_pax_header only overwrites it when the value does not fit the ustar field, so an integer epoch survived and 20 mtimes stayed non-constant
lessons.failure_it_replaces: a partial fix whose output still looked plausible

lessons.rule: Before deferring a residual, ask WHO is missing: a person, a host, a build slice, or us. 'Us' is not a deferral reason.
lessons.measurement: TT-R6-WHEEL-NONREPRODUCIBLE-001 sat in the same list as the host-dependent items, but its missing thing was our own build input; it closed in one round
lessons.failure_it_replaces: a fixable item being re-declared as a known limitation

lessons.rule: A nonce proves the model answered only if the model was asked to say it. The prompt carries the nonce, not just the --nonce flag.
lessons.measurement: the first probe returned ERR_NO_ARM_EMITTED_NONCE with exit=0 and a good usage row; after adding the token to the prompt, 3/3 lanes ok
lessons.failure_it_replaces: concluding that a healthy lane is broken

lessons.rule: An admission that returns an id is not an admission. Read the requirement, taskspec and workorder rows back.
lessons.measurement: admit_requirement returned a workorder id while the TaskSpec was DRAFT and no WorkOrder existed; _repo_head() reads the CALLER's cwd, returned '' outside a repo, and the raised InvariantViolation was swallowed
lessons.failure_it_replaces: trusting an API return value that hides a swallowed exception

lessons.rule: A branch review that is not a measurement is an opinion. merge-tree exit code is the conflict answer; ancestry is the supersede answer.
lessons.measurement: 49 branches measured mechanically collapse to exactly 1 MERGE_NOW
lessons.failure_it_replaces: reviewing branches one at a time by reading diffs

lessons.rule: Before merging a branch to obtain a capability, check whether main already has it.
lessons.measurement: all 8 official PIPD skills are on main with full contracts, typed IO and POS/NEG/EDGE/SEC cases
lessons.failure_it_replaces: merging a branch that only restates main and brings back conflicts

lessons.rule: A pre-authorisation of 'execute your recommendation' is not a grant of a Native effect.
lessons.measurement: the R6 report states the Reviewer recommended a scoped merge and did NOT press the button; merge, release, permission grants and Host plugin creation are separately gated
lessons.failure_it_replaces: reading a broad instruction as a grant of merge/release authority

lessons.trigger: The maker's own reproducibility tests were green, and the independent VERIFY lane mutated the candidate three ways; two mutants still passed.
lessons.measurement: .gitattributes rewritten to eol=crlf -> PASSED (the test only checked the file contained the literal 'eol=lf'); normalise_sdist(sdist, epoch) replaced by pass -> PASSED (the test checked the source for the CALL, so removing it was invisible); .gitattributes deleted -> FAILED, the only mutant that was caught.
lessons.rule: Assert behaviour, not spelling. A source-text assertion survives exactly the mutation it was written to prevent. The durable fix is a mutation probe that breaks the mechanism on purpose in a throwaway copy and asserts the suite goes red. A green suite that cannot fail converts an unverified fix into a claimed verification.
lessons.transferable_to: any candidate that adds a regression test for a mechanism, not just a value

lessons.trigger: The independent checker's venv has no 'build' package, so the candidate's build step failed with 'No module named build.__main__' - an error that reads like a broken artefact.
lessons.measurement: 'import build' succeeds in exactly one ambient interpreter on this machine; the dedicated checker venv does not have it. The artefact was never the problem.
lessons.rule: A tool that produces the evidence must resolve its own dependencies and say what it checked. The resolution order must be explicit and overridable, and the failure message must name the interpreters it tried. When a reviewer hits a dependency error the first question is always 'is this the product or the environment?', and the answer must be mechanically checkable, not asserted.
lessons.transferable_to: every evidence-producing tool an external acceptance officer will run in their own environment

lessons.trigger: The first independent VERIFY round ended exit=1 with the upstream message 'You've hit your usage limit' after 392s of real work.
lessons.measurement: nonce_present=true, usage_status=200, usage_receipt_ok=true, stdout_sha256=80397dbb..., stdout_byte_exact=true. The failure is a provider-side turn.failed, not a candidate failure.
lessons.rule: Classify the exit before classifying the candidate. A provider-side turn.failed after a successful usage receipt is an INCOMPLETE round, not a FAIL verdict and not a PASS: preserve it, do not count it, re-run it. Never round an incomplete round up to a verdict, and never let its incidental findings be lost because the round did not finish.
lessons.transferable_to: every lane dispatch whose exit code can be set by the provider

lessons.trigger: A PASS was recorded on the R7 HGK workorder before the independent checker round 2 existed, because recording the result felt like bookkeeping.
lessons.measurement: The workorder reached VERIFIED with checker='openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol' while the only checker round on record was classified INCOMPLETE_ROUND_PROVIDER_QUOTA. The typed rollback API (rollback_workorder) returned the row to ROLLED_BACK with a rollback_record naming the reason.
lessons.rule: The spine is the acceptance ledger; a premature PASS in it is a false acceptance claim that is indistinguishable from a real one unless withdrawn. Withdraw it with the typed rollback API rather than editing the row, and only re-record a PASS against an actual verdict. The self-check must assert the workorder state, not merely that an evidence list exists.
lessons.transferable_to: every governed round that records a result before its checker has run

residual_split.next_build_slices_note: these four need a NEW admitted WriteSet slice and a real new product surface, or (for the sandbox item) an environment-hardening change to the lane runtime; they are not a documentation task and were NOT closed this round. TT-R6-CHECKER-SANDBOX-ENV-001 was PARTIALLY closed by the lane owner in HG-KSEOS 5d63e00 (G9: a Windows-usable TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP plus PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and -p no:cacheprovider); the residual git-subprocess and site-packages limits remain environmental.

self_iteration.cycle_1: the maker's self-check caught 4 defects in its OWN reading (a row count that included a second table, a reversed ls-remote parse, a residual id with an annotation glued to it, and a missing checker receipt) - all fixed before the evidence was published
self_iteration.cycle_2: the independent checker caught 2 defects in the maker's PRODUCT (F8 source-text tests, F9 ambient-interpreter coupling) - repaired in 59d2138 and re-measured
self_iteration.cycle_3: the spine audit caught a premature PASS - withdrawn with the typed rollback API

self_evolution.delta_1: LEARNING.md grew from 9 to 12 rules; L10-L12 came from an independent lane, not from the maker, which is the point of an independent lane
self_evolution.delta_2: the self-check gained a behavioural requirement: C6 now demands a round that reached a VERDICT and recognises the difference between a failed round and an unrun one
self_evolution.delta_3: the evidence tree now seals the build receipt and the artefacts it describes, and C9 re-derives the digest from the sealed bytes instead of from a scratch path
self_evolution.delta_4: the product's own test suite now contains a mutation probe, so the next maker inherits a check that fails when the mechanism breaks
